description: Statewide enhanced NAIP, high-resolution 6-inch (15 cm) leaf-on digital orthoimagery. Enhanced horizontal accuracy. GeoTIFF, JPEG, Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF (COG). STAC-enabled.
